cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate is supported by a SLES primary cleanser buffered by betaine and a later glucoside, with early peptide, cationic polymer and refatting routes; there is no second independent anionic reset route.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: The position-2 sulfate keeps low off the table, but peptide/polymer/refatting clues keep strong from being the best band.

conditioningLevel.rationale: High conditioning is plausible because peptide, cationic guar and multiple lipid-like/refatting routes occur early enough to matter; confidence stays moderate because there is no silicone and the formula is still sulfate-led.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: No silicone route appears and SLES remains the primary cleanser, so high is plausible but not locked with high confidence.

weightPotential.rationale: Moderate weight potential fits early cationic guar plus peptide and several lipid-like/waxy routes, while the sulfate cleanser and absence of silicone argue against high.
weightPotential.counterSignal: SLES gives moderate reset capacity and there is no nonvolatile silicone or heavy butter/oil route.

unresolvedFacts: PEG-120 Methyl Glucose Dioleate is preserved as thickener/emulsifier and not counted as substantive conditioning.
weightAssessment.whyThisBand: Peptide, cationic guar and lipid-like routes can plausibly leave a bounded residue signal.
weightAssessment.whyNotNeighborBand: High would overread no-silicone rinse-off deposition; low would ignore the early cationic/polymer and refatting convergence.

focusPrimary.rationale: Repair is the strongest formula-first direction because peptide at position 5 and cationic guar at position 6 form a coherent damage-care-compatible route, supported by refatting/lipid-like materials.
focusPrimary.counterSignal: Without claims, this could still resolve to shine or general because the same smoothing/refatting route can serve multiple care stories.

focusSecondary.rationale: No secondary focus is retained because shine/smoothing would reuse the same peptide, polymer and refatting route as the provisional repair focus.
focusSecondary.counterSignal: Visible positioning could later separate shine as a secondary, but blind evidence alone would be route duplication.

usageRole.rationale: Regular is the blind default because the formula has ordinary sulfate cleansing with no recognized treatment active and no explicit reset architecture.
usageRole.counterSignal: The formula is not low cleansing, but strong cleansing alone is not enough to leave regular.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Not targeted is supported because no scalp-active or sensitive-scalp route appears, while fragrance at position 7 and SLES at position 2 are comfort counter-signals.
scalpComfortTarget.counterSignal: Propylene Glycol is humectant-adjacent, but it appears late and does not establish scalp-comfort intent.

dandruffSupport.rationale: Not supported is mechanical: the complete INCI contains neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole.
dandruffSupport.counterSignal: No ingredient in the complete INCI is a v1.4 recognized anti-dandruff active.
